Done. Removed Hrf.params: Map[String, Any], HrfParams.Legacy, HrfParams.toLegacyMap, SpmgParams.toLegacyMap, HrfDescriptor.legacyParams, and the params: Map[String, Any] argument threaded through Hrf.of / Hrf.scalar / Hrf.multi. Hrf.descriptor now defaults to HrfDescriptor.custom(name, nbasis, span) with HrfParams.Empty.

compat/RNames.as_hrf and as_hrf_multi also lose their params argument: they were the only callers passing one, they have zero consumers anywhere in the repo, and a parameter that silently discards its argument would be worse than none.

Nothing referenced any of it — the removal compiled and all suites passed with no other edit. Verified JVM+JS.
